title: Jiangsu Hengsheng Information Technology (江苏恒盛信息技术 / hensun.com)
description:
IT services / hospital IT outsourcing · China
Full data leak: 2026-11-13 20:11 UTC
A copy of the workforce management system of a Chinese information technology services company, including personnel records for 725 employees with national identity numbers, names, dates of birth, phone numbers and addresses, attendance punch history of more than 200,000 records, WeChat check-in history of more than 100,000 records, and the database operation log. Will be published if the situation is not resolved.
